principles: Actor gameplay role never rewrites canonical identity, profession, species, faction or narrative state.
Hostility is explicit runtime state; NPC class alone never makes an actor hostile.
Player primary-click attacks a target automatically only when Stage07 hostility resolves HOSTILE; neutral actors remain contextual interactions.
Detailed actor state uses lazy active-set materialization for country-scale performance.
Combat rank is GAMEPLAY_DERIVED and scales combat overlays without canon mutation.
godot_dependency: NONE_FOR_STAGE07_CORE; direct editor validation deferred until user is on PC

combat_roll_seed_policy.reason: Runtime UUID is identity metadata and must not alter gameplay outcomes.
